turnPolicy.coverage: Recognized degree-two same-net same-layer straight-segment endpoints only; other geometry is not proven compliant.

limitations: Only top-level straight segments with resolved nets and degree-two same-layer endpoints have sequential turn measurements.
Geometry-only extraction does not check widths, vias, electrical stackup, current capacity, impedance, clearance or fabrication suitability.
Zero direction change means a straight continuation; 180 degrees means reversal and is not permitted. Overlaps may prevent sequential-turn inference.
No automatic design acceptance: original findings and incomplete coverage remain authoritative.
Reviewed numerical width/via/net-class constraints do not supply current, voltage, temperature rise, impedance or fabricator qualification evidence.

scope: Same saved native PCB, original frozen-host analyzer versus corrected working source. The original native validation is retained. This does not deploy a replacement host, resolve four junctions, or establish electrical/board acceptance.
